metadata.method: one untimed warm-up, then five serial wall-clock samples per case

algorithm_paper.title: Graph Drawing by Stochastic Gradient Descent
algorithm_paper.schedule: Section II-A1 selects t_max=15 and epsilon=0.1 as a speed-quality compromise

metadata.stress: sum over unordered pairs of ((Euclidean distance - unweighted shortest-path distance) / shortest-path distance)^2; per_pair divides by 4950; coordinates are not rescaled
metadata.comparability: s_gd2 optimizes this stress objective. igraph FR and KK timings are separate layout objectives, so their diagnostic stress values are not quality comparisons.
